summary: Frontend-only role-path regression executed on public preview URL. Pending credential lock-state flow and admin moderation/memberships workflows are functionally working, with intermittent Supabase/network rate-limit instability observed during multi-login run.

integration_issues.flow: Sequential pending->admin login in one automation session
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent auth/network instability observed: TypeError Failed to fetch with repeated 429 responses and Vite websocket 429 during one run; admin path required clean retest session.

action_items: Stabilize Supabase/auth request handling under repeated session changes to prevent intermittent 429/Failed-to-fetch failures.
Keep analytics event inserts (lock-state CTA/report tracking) non-blocking as currently implemented; verify server-side quotas/rate limits in preview environment.
After infra stabilization, re-run single-session pending->admin workflow to confirm no transient auth selector timeouts.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested selectors regression is good: login-form-email-input, login-form-password-input, login-form-submit-button are present and usable.
Admin protection remains intact: pending member navigation to /admin/feed redirected to /dashboard.
Legacy fallback behavior on /admin/community-memberships is working and visible when community_memberships table is unavailable (404s observed, fallback banner rendered).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md values: pending.member.20260603@example.com / PendingPass123!, admin.member.20260603@example.com / AdminPass123!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested feature checks passed on public URL: pending lock-state + CTA non-break, admin moderation queue visibility, admin memberships legacy fallback, protected admin route behavior. One combined run showed transient 429/fetch failures during account switch; admin-only clean rerun passed.
rca of the issue: RCA for intermittent failure: In combined pending->admin run, browser console showed repeated 429 responses, Supabase auth refresh fetch failure, and Vite websocket handshake 429. This produced temporary UI load failure where login selectors timed out. Separate clean-session admin retest succeeded, indicating environmental/transient rate-limiting instability rather than deterministic selector or route bug.
